I couldn't open the PR: the token this run uses has no access to `cv/pit`. GitHub reports `push`, `pull` and every other permission on that repo as `false`, and forking it fails with `403 Resource not accessible by integration`. The pi-action-agent app would need to be installed on `cv/pit` with write access to contents and pull requests. Once it is, ask again and I'll open the PR.

So that you don't have to wait, I made the fix on pit's current `main` as a commit. Its tests in `test/tool/input.test.ts` pass (19). Save this as `pit-fix.patch` and apply it with `git am pit-fix.patch` in a checkout of `cv/pit`:

```diff
From 33746cb5ba4e1d2c0a863bf67a3e9b40e59660a4 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: "pi-action-agent[bot]"
 <355532786+pi-action-agent[bot]@users.noreply.github.com>
Subject: [PATCH] fix(tool): decode a JSON-encoded string in params

A model sent a PR body to a (body: string) program as a JSON string
literal, quotes and \n escapes included. resolveToolInput passed it
through because the input admits a string, so gh posted the encoded
text (cv/pi-action#76). Decode a string that is a JSON string literal
for every input.
---
 src/tool/input.ts       | 15 +++++++++++++--
 test/tool/input.test.ts | 12 ++++++++++++
 2 files changed, 25 insertions(+), 2 deletions(-)

diff --git a/src/tool/input.ts b/src/tool/input.ts
index e8b5dcf..eaa8cd5 100644
--- a/src/tool/input.ts
+++ b/src/tool/input.ts
@@ -3,11 +3,22 @@ import { programInputAdmitsString } from "../functions/source.js";
 /**
  * Some clients deliver the `params` tool argument as a JSON string. Decode a string that holds a
  * JSON object or array when the program's declared input cannot accept a string; otherwise pass
- * the value through unchanged so validation reports any mismatch against the declared type.
+ * the value through unchanged so validation reports any mismatch against the declared type. A
+ * string that is itself a JSON string literal ("line\\nline") is decoded for every input.
  */
 export function resolveToolInput(source: string, params: unknown): un
